```{r setup, include=FALSE}
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(scales)
library(sjPlot)
```

```{r load-packages}
source("02_func_analysis.R")
source("11_DataCleaning.R")
source("test_clean.R")
```

```{r}
# Fit models
formula <- as.formula(primary_win ~ party + gender + race + ideology + incumbent)
model_all <- run_logistic_model(all_candidates, formula)

# Tidy results
tidy_results <- tidy_model_output(model_all)

# Plot coefficients
plot_model_coefficients(model_all, "Predictors of Primary Success (All Candidates)")

# Compare by party
party_results <- party_comparison_models(all_candidates, formula)

# Predicted probabilities
visualize_predicted_probabilities(model_all, "gender", all_candidates)

##
##Q1 VISUALISATIONS
##

#  win rate by gender
ggplot(candidates_q1, aes(gender, primary_outcome)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", fill = "grey") +
  labs(title = "Primary Win Rate by Gender",
       y = "Win Rate", x = "Gender") +
  theme_minimal()

#win rate by gender seperated into parties
ggplot(candidates_q1, aes(gender, primary_outcome, fill = party)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Win Rate by Gender and Party",
       y = "Win Rate", x = "Gender") +
  theme_minimal()

# histogram of vote % by gender
ggplot(candidates_q1, aes(primary_percent, fill = gender)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  labs(title="Distribution of Primary Vote % by Gender",
       x="Primary Vote %", y="Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# win rate by race
ggplot(candidates_q1, aes(race, primary_outcome)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", fill="orange") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title="Primary Win Rate by Race", y="Win Rate", x="Race") +
  theme_minimal()

# win rate by gender × race
ggplot(candidates_q1, aes(x = gender, y = primary_outcome, fill = race)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Primary Win Rate by Gender and Race",
       x = "Gender", y = "Win Rate", fill = "Race") +
  theme_minimal()

# win rate by gender × race seperated by party
ggplot(candidates_q1, aes(x = gender, y = primary_outcome, fill = race)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  facet_wrap(~ party) +
  labs(title = "Win Rate by Gender and Race, Separated by Party",
       x = "Gender", y = "Win Rate", fill = "Race") +
  theme_minimal()

# win rate by office
ggplot(candidates_q1, aes(office, primary_outcome)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Win Rate by Office", y = "Win Rate", x = "Office") +
  theme_minimal()

# logistic regression fit
model <- glm(primary_outcome ~ primary_percent, data=candidates_q1, family="binomial")

# scatter + logistic curve
ggplot(candidates_q1, aes(primary_percent, primary_outcome)) +
  geom_jitter(height=0.05, alpha=0.5) +
  stat_smooth(method="glm", method.args=list(family="binomial"), se=TRUE, color="red") +
  labs(title="Logistic Regression of Win Probability vs Primary %", 
       x="Primary Vote %", y="Win Probability") +
  theme_minimal()
```
